title: The Case of the Lantern Room
story: Lena has two puzzles. The old one: since early November, the Keeper's Lamp's brass has shone as if someone polished it, and none of her volunteers did. The new one: muddy footprints on the spiral stair on Wednesday morning, though it was spotless when the museum closed at a quarter to six on Tuesday. Five people climbed the tower on Tuesday, each stopping at a different landing with something different in hand. Who went back up after closing time?

question.text: Who climbed the tower after closing?

texts: Of Cass and the climber with the flashlight, one stopped at the 3rd landing and the other stopped at the top.
Of Jonah and the climber with the flashlight, one stopped at the 2nd landing and the other stopped at the 3rd landing.
Wren climbed later than the climber with the thermos.
Jonah climbed earlier than the climber with the thermos.
The climber with the thermos climbed at either 4:30 p.m. or 5:30 p.m.
Hugo did not climb at 5:30 p.m.
Of Teddy and the climber with the thermos, one stopped at the top and the other stopped at the 1st landing.
Jonah carried neither the sketchbook nor the thermos.
The climber with the notebook climbed exactly 60 minutes after the climber who stopped at the 1st landing.
